name: Signature
pose: He stands with weight shifted onto one leg, shoulders loose and ready, a confident, determined gaze toward the camera — a battle-ready stance, his expression calm and centered, utterly still despite the crackling energy around him.
effects: A faint arc of electric-gold static crackles around his hands.

components.companion: his bonded Gryphon, a majestic eagle-lion hybrid with storm-grey feathers, perched on a nearby ledge, wings mantled

notes: First-pass minimal signature scene — reuses the striker-group default wardrobe set + the existing castle background.
